title: 正则化强调时序差分学习：恒定步长下的稳定性
summary: 本文研究强调时序差分学习（ETD）在恒定步长下的稳定性问题，构造了一个遍历二状态反例，表明ETD均值映射收缩时采样乘积仍可能具有正Lyapunov指数。作者提出正则化强调TD（RETD），通过归一化的一阶冲击后修复机制，在不改变迹和重要性比率的前提下实现稳定，并证明了几乎必然收敛性。
summary_en: This paper studies stability of emphatic temporal-difference learning (ETD) under constant stepsizes. The authors construct an ergodic two-state counterexample where the ETD mean map contracts but the sampled product has a positive top Lyapunov exponent. They introduce regularized emphatic TD (RETD), a normalized first-order post-shock repair that leaves traces and importance ratios unchanged, and prove almost-sure convergence for harmonic diminishing stepsizes plus a conditional constant-stepsize moment-contraction result.
